field.label: Enable DHCP Interface HA
field.help: Enable CARP-aware exclusive attachment for the selected IPv4 DHCP interface.

field.label: Managed OPNsense Interface
field.help: The logical OPNsense interface managed by this plugin. Version 1 requires IPv4 DHCP.

field.label: Shared interface MAC
field.help: Ordinary unicast MAC presented to the upstream network by the active node. Use Generate Private MAC when no network-specific MAC is required.

field.label: Failback Delay
field.help: Use zero in this experimental release. Delayed failback is not implemented; native CARP preemption policy applies.
